questions.stem: 相較於向銀行貸款，群眾募資（crowdfunding）讓更多人有機會實現夢想，無論他們手上有多少錢。
questions.answer: Compared with taking out bank loans, crowdfunding offers more people the opportunity to fulfill their dreams, no matter how much money they have.
accepted_answers: Compared with borrowing money from banks, crowdfunding gives more people a chance to realize their dreams, no matter how much money they have.
In comparison with getting a bank loan, crowdfunding allows more people to make their dreams come true, no matter how much money they have.

patterns: 讓步：無論…（no matter how much：無論他們手上有多少錢）
相較於…（比較片語＋比較級 more people）

1.explanation_zh: 「在贊助…之前」和主要子句的主詞都是「許多人」，可以用連接詞＋分詞的省略寫法 Before supporting a crowdfunding campaign, …（完整的寫法是 Before they support …，主詞相同時省略主詞、動詞改成 V-ing）。「群眾募資的計畫」是正在募款的案子，用 campaign 或 project。「上網查看」是 go online to check（online 是副詞，前面不加 to）。「發起人過去做過的事」不必譯出「事」，用 what 名詞子句 what its creators have done in the past 當 check 的受詞，子句內用直述句語序；中文「發起人」不分單複數，its creator has done 或 its creators have done 都可以，助動詞要和主詞一致。
evidence: 在贊助群眾募資（crowdfunding）的計畫之前
1.strategy_zh: 先確認「贊助」和「查看」是同一群人做的，才能用 Before + V-ing；受詞「…做過的事」改成 what 子句，最後檢查 creator(s) 和 has／have 是否一致。
hints: 切成四段：在贊助／群眾募資的計畫／許多人會先上網查看／發起人過去做過的事
標的詞彙：support（贊助）、project（計畫、案子）、online（在網路上）、creator（發起人）、past（過去）
句型框架：Before + V-ing …, S + V + to VR + what + S + have p.p. …

2.explanation_zh: 「相較於向銀行貸款」用 Compared with taking out bank loans 或 Compared with borrowing money from banks（with 後面接名詞或動名詞；「向…借」是 borrow from）。主要子句要帶出比較：crowdfunding offers more people the opportunity to fulfill their dreams（或 gives more people a chance to …、allows more people to …）。句尾「無論他們手上有多少錢」是讓步，「無論」後面是完整的子句（他們＋有＋多少錢），英文用 no matter how much money they have：money 不可數，用 how much；no matter 子句用直述句語序。
evidence: 讓更多人有機會實現夢想
無論他們手上有多少錢
2.strategy_zh: 句首比較片語、中間主要子句（記得有 more people）、句尾 no matter how much 子句，三段各自檢查語序與可數、不可數。
hints: 切成四段：相較於向銀行貸款／群眾募資讓更多人有機會／實現夢想／無論他們手上有多少錢
標的詞彙：compare（比較）、bank（銀行）、opportunity（機會）、dream（夢想）、money（錢）
句型框架：Compared with + V-ing …, S + offer + more + N + the opportunity to VR …, no matter how much + N + S + V

bonus.text: Unlike bank loans, crowdfunding opens the door for far more people to turn their dreams into reality, however little money they may have.
bonus.explanation_zh: 用 however + adj. + S + V（＝no matter how …）表讓步，搭配 open the door for sb（為某人打開大門）、turn … into reality（把…變成現實）；比較改用 unlike，句意更精練。

2.restructuring_zh: 「讓更多人有機會實現夢想」不要照字面寫 let more people have chance，英文用 give sb a chance to VR 或 allow sb to VR；「無論他們手上有多少錢」放在句尾，寫成 no matter how much money they have 的讓步子句，子句內用直述句語序。

1.translation: Before sponsoring a crowdfunding project, many people first go online to check what its organizer has done in the past.
1.explanation_zh: 「在……之前」主詞相同，用 Before + V-ing；「會先上網查看」是一般習慣，用現在式 first go online to check；「發起人過去做過的事」用 what 名詞子句當 check 的受詞，「做過」用現在完成式 has done。「發起人」可譯 organizer／creator／founder，選 organizer。

2.translation: Compared with borrowing money from banks, crowdfunding gives more people the chance to realize their dreams, no matter how much money they have.
2.explanation_zh: 「相較於向銀行貸款」用 Compared with + V-ing（borrowing money from banks）；「讓更多人有機會實現夢想」用 give sb the chance to V；「無論他們手上有多少錢」用 no matter how much money they have，「手上」不必直譯。

issues_zh: 加分寫法 Only after looking into what the creators have achieved in the past do many people decide to back a crowdfunding project. 漏譯「上網」（第 3 部分，標的詞 online），achieved（成就）把「做過的事」窄化成正面成果，only after … do … decide 也把「會先查看」說成「查過才決定贊助」；建議保留 go online 與 have done。四個參考譯文本身正確。
（供參考）標的句型標成 PART（gp-conj-participle），但 Before + V-ing 的 before 也可以看成介系詞＋動名詞（PREPVING）；不影響本次判定，人工審核時可確認分類。

problems: 第 1 題驗證者對參考譯文有意見（warn）：加分寫法 Only after looking into what the creators have achieved in the past do many people decide to back a crowdfunding pr

1.translation: Before backing a crowdfunding project, many people go online to check what its creator has done in the past.
1.explanation_zh: 「在贊助……之前」用 Before + V-ing（Before backing ...），主詞 many people 與 backing 的動作者一致，不會有懸垂分詞問題；「贊助」譯成 back（也可用 support）；「上網查看」go online to check；「發起人過去做過的事」用名詞子句 what its creator has done in the past，過去做過、與現在有關所以用現在完成式。

2.translation: Compared with borrowing money from a bank, crowdfunding gives more people the chance to realize their dreams, no matter how much money they have.
2.explanation_zh: 「相較於向銀行貸款」用 Compared with + 動名詞片語 borrowing money from a bank，與主詞 crowdfunding 的比較對象是「貸款這種做法」，兩者詞性對等；「讓更多人有機會……」用 give more people the chance to + V；「實現夢想」是 realize their dreams；「無論他們手上有多少錢」用 no matter how much money they have 放句尾，表示讓步。
